eslint.config.ts.name: Content lint config
eslint.config.ts.description: Enables every docs/* rule on content/**/*.mdx and *.md through the docs/mdx and docs/markdown languages, plus frontmatter-schema on pages.

eslint/language.ts.name: MDX language for ESLint
eslint/language.ts.description: Parses a file with micromark plus MDX, GFM, math and frontmatter into the mdast tree the site compiles, offered to rules as node visitors.

eslint/plugin.ts.name: Docs rule plugin
eslint/plugin.ts.description: Registers the eighteen docs/* rules and the two content languages as the docs ESLint plugin; CONTENT_RULES leaves out frontmatter-schema.

eslint/shared.ts.name: Rule helpers
eslint/shared.ts.description: Supplies what the rules share: the rule type, code-masked source text, a flat list of JSX elements with context, and the registered component set.
